messages:
Mike: quick follow-up from the postmortem — I sketched a tiny bridge plan to convert incident learnings into concrete tests. TL;DR: owners, timelines, and a lightweight triage -> test pipeline.
Alina: love that. can you paste the plan here?
Mike: sure — high level: 1) tag incident with test-types (regression/prompt/load/chaos), 2) assign test owner within 3 business days, 3) create eval PR + minimal promptset within 7 days, 4) schedule a chaos drill if pattern recurs twice in 30d.
Cheng: how do we decide "pattern"? noisy alerts could be misleading.
Sara: propose threshold = 2 customer-impact incidents OR 3 degraded-SLO incidents in 30d for the same service/model route. keep it conservative.
Jamie: can we reuse the existing regression infra? we don't want lots of one-off harnesses.
Mike: yes — reuse eval-runner + CI job template. owners only need to add promptset + baseline expectations. eval-bot can run nightly on a branch.
Alina: speaking of owners — suggest rotating primary between ML and SRE for 30d windows for cross-ownership. e.g., next window: Cheng (SRE) primary, Alina backup.
Cheng: ok with that. I'll take the next window. can we make an automated reminder in #eng-oncall?
Mike: yep — I added a tiny workflow: when a PM closes postmortem with tag "requires-test", it creates a draft issue in RD backlog board with template. also sends /remind to owner 3d after creation.
Sara: can you share the issue template?
Mike: paste: ```Title: Incident -> Eval: RD-<incident-id> Summary: short cause + reproduction steps Test type: regression|prompt|load|chaos Owner: @owner Deadline (suggested): 7d Acceptance: eval passes baseline and is added to nightly pipeline```
Alina: acceptance criteria looks good. add a field: "rollback plan if test unstable" — helps engineers know next steps.
Mike: added that.
Jamie: how do we prioritize these against other e2e/regression work? we can't overload QE.
Sara: priority = P1 for incidents causing customer impact within 72h, P2 otherwise. P1 blocks other non-critical work for the owner.
Cheng: about chaos drills — who coordinates them? ops? SRE?
Alina: ops + platform coordinate scheduling, SRE leads the drill. owners propose drill scope in the issue if pattern hit.
Mike: quick nit: we need observability hooks in evals so console can show when a recent test failed and link to incident. small API change needed. tagging @eng-platform.
Jamie: noted — will open a tiny ticket to add eval->console link. RD-4321.
eval-bot: nightly run: branch incident-evals/rd-2107 completed 2023-11-02 03:40UTC — 2 failures (prompt-regression). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/2107
Alina: thanks eval-bot. Cheng, can you triage those 2 failures this week and either fix or mark flaky?
Cheng: will do. aim for EOD Thursday.
Mike: final ask — let's trial this pipeline for 30 days and review at next postmortem-sync. owners, please update the issue with status every 3 days. short comments are fine.
Sara: approved. I've added recurring review agenda item.
Mike: awesome. assigning owners now: RD-2107 -> Cheng, RD-2112 -> Alina. I'll follow up with reminders. :thumbsup:
Cheng: got it.
Alina: on it.
Jamie: I'll create the console link ticket and ping eng-platform.
Mike: thanks everyone — closing thread, will publish the short checklist to the handbook after 1st trial.
